title: Egoroff's theorem on ℝⁿ: a closed set of almost full measure with uniform convergence on bounded parts
statement: Let n ∈ ℕ, let C ⊆ ℝⁿ (ℝⁿ = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) be a Borel set, and let f_k : ℝⁿ → ℝ (k ∈ ℕ) and g : ℝⁿ → ℝ be Borel measurable with f_k(x) → g(x) for every x ∈ C. Let ε ∈ (0, ∞]. Then there is a closed set A ⊆ ℝⁿ with A ⊆ C and Lⁿ(C ∖ A) < ε (Lⁿ = volume) such that, for every R ∈ ℝ, f_k → g uniformly on A ∩ B̄_R(0).
lean_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (C : Set (Eucl n)) (f : ℕ → Eucl n → ℝ) (g : Eucl n → ℝ), MeasurableSet C → (∀ k, Measurable (f k)) → Measurable g → (∀ x ∈ C, Tendsto (fun k => f k x) atTop (𝓝 (g x))) → ∀ ε : ℝ≥0∞, 0 < ε → ∃ A : Set (Eucl n), IsClosed A ∧ A ⊆ C ∧ (volume : Measure (Eucl n)) (C \ A) < ε ∧ ∀ R : ℝ, TendstoUniformlyOn f g atTop (A ∩ closedBall 0 R)
